text:
anna-cloud: Quick sync — we're greenlighting eu-central-2 (AWS) expansion with NVIDIA Cloud OEM as our hardware partner. Need to coordinate marketplace listing approvals, reserved capacity, and quota increases. Proposed launch window: 2025-02-10 to 2025-02-17. :rocket:

samir-ops: Got it. Do we have the quota request ready for the cloud account? I'll need that to lock capacity with infra partner.

anna-cloud: Drafted one — see snippet below. Can someone (maya-mlinfra) validate GPU types and hours? Also tagging laura-legal for marketplace T&C review.

anna-cloud: ```
{
  "region": "eu-central-2",
  "gpu_profile": "8xA100-80GB",
  "reserved_hours_per_month": "720",
  "expected_traffic_tier": "mid-high",
  "billing_entity": "redwood-dedicated-eu"
}
```

maya-mlinfra: Profile looks right for current benchmarks, but suggest we add a fallback smaller bundle (4xA100) for initial canary. Saves cost if traffic low.

samir-ops: Good call. I'll split the reservation into 8xA100 primary + 4xA100 canary. Need partner contact for formal quota ticket — @chris-partners can you share vendor contact and marketplace PM? :eyes: 

chris-partners: Sharing now — vendor contact is emily@nvidia-cloud.com. Marketplace PM is pierre@aws-marketplace. I'll intro them and include our standard checklist (SLA, logos, billing SKUs, legal docs).

laura-legal: I'll review marketplace listing terms and the OEM co-marketing language. Please send any proposed joint press copy before we loop in comms. Also confirm data flow diagrams for the private tenancy option — legal needs that for GDPR checklist.

anna-cloud: Noted. I'll attach dataflow and a short draft for joint announcement by EOD. Anyone object to the two-week window? We need partner approvals + marketplace review to clear.

maya-mlinfra: No objection. For rollout plan: week 1 canary on 4xA100 with routing policies and autoscale off; week 2 increase to 8xA100 and enable autoscale/burst. We'll run perf regression evals during canary.

samir-ops: I'll open the formal AWS quota ticket today; ETA for quota increase is typically 5 business days, but with partner PM ping might be faster. Creating a capacity reservation in our Dedicated system once quota approved.

chris-partners: Intro sent to emily and pierre. They asked for a SKU mapping spreadsheet and confirmation of supported AMIs/containers. I'll upload that to the shared drive.

deploy-bot: marketplace-draft created: https://drive.redwood/repo/eu-central-2-marketplace-draft (permissions: partnerships read, legal read).

laura-legal: Received. Reviewing T&Cs now — flagging two clauses around indemnity and data processing that we should tighten.

anna-cloud: Action items recap: 1) samir: open quota ticket + create capacity reservation (due +2d). 2) chris: send SKU & AMI details to vendor (done). 3) maya: prepare canary perf evals and fallback config. 4) laura: legal review + signoff on marketplace language. 5) anna: draft joint announcement and dataflow diagrams.

samir-ops: I'll update this thread when quota ticket #AW-4982 is created.

chris-partners: vendor replied — they can prioritize approvals if we provide completed compliance checklist by EOD tomorrow.

anna-cloud: Perfect. I'll circulate the checklist and the draft announcement shortly. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
